rationale.text: The page's only link is an SVG a element with xlink:href, holding a title element as a direct child and a text element. The glossary counts an a tag with xlink:href in SVG 1.1 as a link, and builds an SVG link's name from the title element that is a direct child of the link, or else from the text of its text elements. Both give Accueil. The custom check collects them and answers no_fault, so the finding is needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only, and would be passed at full.

citations.quote: Balise <a> possédant un attribut xlink:href en SVG 1.1.
Sinon, contenu de l’élément <title> enfant direct du lien ;
Sinon, contenu texte d’un ou plusieurs éléments <text>.
